source_api: official Wikidata REST item labels and property-filtered statements, 67 per-response records
graph_unit: one static purposive panel, not iid graph samples
split_unit: all projected P30 values for a QID grouped by fixed hash
feature_labels: ONLY train P30 inverse seeds; no val/test seed, no P47 self edge; supervised feature construction, not presample fixed encoder
negative_assumption: candidate not in best-rank projection is coded zero for record-reconstruction benchmark, not certified false in the world
time_scope: multiple property retrieval timestamps, no reliable event-time split
preview: 20 epochs also computed test outputs after its own selection; only resource output inspected; no protocol change
